resources.name: Authority
resources.description: Authority maximum equals casting ability modifier (minimum 1). Spend it on Commands and regain it from qualifying enemy defeats.

resources.name: Thread of Life
resources.description: Combined daily uses: one at 5th level plus one at 9th, 13th, and 17th.

power_providers.label: Rogue Talents in place of Bestial Traits
power_providers.description: A Bestial Trait slot may instead hold a Rogue Talent, using Shifter level as Rogue level.

choice_providers.label: Paragon Good Saves
choice_providers.description: Choose two good saves; the remaining save uses the poor progression.

choice_providers.label: Focused Improvement
choice_providers.description: At 8th level choose poison immunity or an origin talent. Choosing the origin talent also forgoes disease immunity at 12th.

entries.choice_handling_note: Channel polarity is forced to negative and Master of Life and Death is replaced by the Mind sphere.

resources.name: Proclamation
resources.description: Spend one Channel Energy use to proclaim a friend or foe of the court.
